analysis_role: Secondary source-defined survival trajectory; rank persistence
participants_and_samples: GEO states 35 sepsis patients (26 survivors, 9 nonsurvivors) plus 18 controls; 163 array samples total; 127 sepsis sample rows
timepoints: Day 1 to Day 5; 35 baseline sepsis samples; 31/28/19/14 at 24/48/72/96 h
patient_sample_mapping: Recoverable from title for the 35 baseline patients; one orphan Day-4 nonsurvivor title ID=20 creates a 36th parsed sepsis ID and conflicts with the series-level n=35
clinical_anchor: Survivor/nonsurvivor label available, but the mortality horizon is not defined in the accessible GEO deposit or PubMed abstract
expression_and_platform: Public processed series matrix; GPL6947 Illumina HumanHT-12 v3; existing reconstruction scored all 8 signatures in 163/163 samples
fixed_signature_status: READY for the baseline-defined paired subset; all eight scores already pass QC
blocking_issue: Outcome horizon unresolved; orphan ID20; strong differential attrition over days
recommended_action: Exclude orphan ID20 from clinical models; call the endpoint source-defined survival; keep the extended Day-1-to-Day-5 model secondary and report risk sets by day

participants_and_samples: 51 septic shock patients plus 22 controls; 124 samples; 51 complete patient pairs
timepoints: Admission/D1 plus D2 for 20 patients or D3 for 31 patients
patient_sample_mapping: Complete patient IDs in titles; 51/51 pairs resolved
clinical_anchor: Explicit day-28 survival; 34 survivors and 17 nonsurvivors in the 51-patient expression cohort
expression_and_platform: Public processed series matrix; GPL570 Affymetrix HG-U133 Plus 2.0; existing reconstruction scored all 8 signatures in 124/124 samples
fixed_signature_status: READY; all eight scores already pass QC
blocking_issue: Second measurement mixes D2 and D3; follow-up timing differs modestly by outcome group
recommended_action: Model paired score change with survival status and exact follow-up day; add D2/D3-stratified sensitivity; do not label every second sample as 48 h

participants_and_samples: 31 septic shock patients; 62 RNA-seq samples; 17 responders and 14 nonresponders
timepoints: T1 within 16 h of ICU admission; T2 48 h after study enrolment
patient_sample_mapping: All 31 pairs recoverable because sample title, source name, and raw-count column name agree; the separate GEO timepoint characteristic conflicts in 21/62 records
clinical_anchor: Nonresponder defined as SOFA(T1)-SOFA(T2) <5 AND SOFA(T2)>8; all remaining patients are responders
expression_and_platform: Public gene-level raw-count XLSX; GRCh38/GENCODE v25; 56 samples GPL16791 HiSeq 2500 and 6 GPL10999 GAIIx; within-patient pairs stay on one platform; existing reconstruction scored all 8 signatures in 62/62 samples
fixed_signature_status: READY; all eight scores already pass QC
blocking_issue: GEO timepoint-characteristic misassignment in 21 records could reverse time if used naively
recommended_action: Freeze title plus source-name plus raw-count-column concordance as the time authority; preserve the 21-record conflict log; use the deposited R/NR label without redefining it

analysis_role: Primary SAPSII severity-group anchoring; rank persistence
participants_and_samples: 28 septic shock patients plus 25 controls; 107 samples
timepoints: H0 and H24 for 28/28; H48 for 26/28
patient_sample_mapping: Patient IDs and exact collection times recoverable from titles; patient-level SAPSII-High/Low is repeated in GEO metadata
clinical_anchor: Patient-level binary SAPSII group available: 14 Low and 14 High; paper defines Low <45 and High >45. Exact numeric SAPSII and patient-level 28-day deaths are not public in GEO
expression_and_platform: Public processed series matrix; GPL570 Affymetrix HG-U133 Plus 2.0; existing reconstruction scored all 8 signatures in 107/107 samples
fixed_signature_status: READY for binary severity anchoring; all eight scores already pass QC
blocking_issue: Only the frozen binary SAPSII class is recoverable; two H48 samples are missing; 5/28 deaths are reported only in aggregate by severity group
recommended_action: Use the deposited SAPSII-High/Low class, not reconstructed numeric scores; report H48 complete-pair count; do not use this dataset for patient-level mortality anchoring

analysis_role: Independent directional replication; secondary 28-day mortality anchoring with treatment control
participants_and_samples: 47 CORTICUS septic shock patients; 94 array samples; 24 hydrocortisone and 23 placebo
timepoints: Pre-treatment and 24 h post-treatment; 47/47 complete pairs
patient_sample_mapping: Complete patient, time, treatment, 28-day survival, ACTH-response, and IFNG/IL10 strata in GEO series matrix
clinical_anchor: 28-day survival available for all 47: 34 survived and 13 died
expression_and_platform: Public normalized series matrix and non-normalized file; GPL10295 Illumina Human-6 v2; prior audit covered all 74 component genes and reconstructed all 8 signatures
fixed_signature_status: READY and already completed: 47 pairs, all 8 formulas; four diagnostic-score directions reproduced
blocking_issue: Randomized hydrocortisone exposure can affect 24-h trajectories; the same cohort cannot be counted as two independent validations
recommended_action: Retain as external directional replication. If mortality anchoring is added, adjust or stratify by treatment and label it secondary within the same cohort

analysis_role: Conditional new external D1-to-D3/D7 RNA-seq replication
participants_and_samples: 11 patients (5 sepsis, 6 septic shock) plus 4 healthy controls; 35 ENA runs/samples; 31 patient samples
timepoints: Ten patients have complete D1/D3/D7 series; septic-shock patient 00 has D1 only
patient_sample_mapping: ENA sample titles give a complete run-to-sample-to-clinical-group-to-day mapping; patient 00 is a distinct sixth shock patient, consistent with the paper's one D1-only participant
clinical_anchor: Article reports group-level clinical outcomes and longitudinal SOFA summaries, but ENA has no patient-level clinical-outcome mapping suitable for anchoring
expression_and_platform: Raw paired-end NovaSeq X Plus FASTQs only; 174571503968 compressed bytes (162.58 GiB). ENA analysis query returned header only. Article says processed data and scripts are available from the authors on request
fixed_signature_status: NOT YET RECONSTRUCTED; fixed formulas are technically plausible after a full gene-level pipeline but public gene coverage and score equivalence have not been demonstrated
blocking_issue: No public count/TPM matrix or ENA analysis object; large raw download and full reprocessing required; small n=10 complete trajectories
recommended_action: First request the StringTie gene-count/TPM matrix and sample key from the authors. If unavailable, treat FASTQ processing as a separate resource-gated task; do not start the 162.58-GiB download during manuscript editing
